title: This Forest Is Actually One Living Thing Weighing 13 Million Pounds

scenes.text: This forest is actually one single living thing.
It's called Pando, in Utah. About 47,000 aspen trunks share one root system.
All of them are genetically identical.
It covers 106 acres, about the size of 80 football fields.
It weighs around 13 million pounds, the heaviest known living organism.
Its roots may be thousands of years old.

description:
This forest is actually one single living thing.
Pando in Utah is a colony of about 47,000 aspen trunks connected by one root system. It covers 106 acres, weighs around 13 million pounds, and is the heaviest known living organism.
Would you have guessed that was one tree? Comment below.
first_comment: Individual trunks live about 130 years, but the root system keeps going. Which is the real tree, the trunk or the roots?
